verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents multi-location operation: a centralized back office supporting 1,000+ locations, per-location inventory that syncs in real time, transfers and shipments between locations, and general reporting and analytics. However, the evidence does not show per-location device assignment, per-location settings, or reporting broken down by location. missing for 10: per-location device management, per-location settings configuration, location-level reporting breakdowns, independent/hands-on corroboration.
